segments.text: his parachute is in shreds, his bomber is going down, and he's heading for a train station's glass roof.
Daylight, over Saint-Nazaire. Flak wrecks his ball turret. He crawls out. His parachute is torn to rags.
Short of oxygen, he blacks out, and the bomber throws him clear. {22,000|Twenty-two thousand} feet.
And right below him: the railway station. Glass, and iron.
He smashes straight through. The glass bursts, and slows him. Just enough.
They find him in the station, alive. Twenty-eight shrapnel wounds, and a badly injured arm.
A German military doctor saves him. He sees out the war as a prisoner, and goes home.
Seven of his crew never did. Fifty years on, Saint-Nazaire built them a memorial. Case closed. Now picture it:
